mission: Develop the lattice resonance from theory to executable plan and secure Sera's commitment.
why_now: Torin is gone. The group's strongest member and his approach are no longer available. Ben must find an alternative or cede the field to Veraine. Gavran's resonance note is the only lead.
conflict: Ben vs. the gap between theory and execution — untested, theoretical, desperate last option
turning_point: Gavran's resonance note crystallizes into a plan: three traditions working in harmonic concert. Untested, theoretical, but it's all they have. Sera agrees. Kael is the holdout.
emotional_trajectory: The solution requires living the theme to execute it
notes: Plan established: three practitioners (Sera, Kael, Ben) working in concert; Desh disrupting Veraine's infrastructure. Sera agrees. Kael is the holdout.
